description: Shared celebratory-confirmation composition — icon/illustration -> title -> description -> primary action -> optional secondary action, centered, single column, at every breakpoint.
structure: icon.large or custom illustration, color.success.default, animated entrance
motionRule: entrance is motion.duration.slow + easing.decelerate under normal motion preference; an opacity cross-fade at motion.duration.fast (or instant appearance) under reduced-motion — unconditionally, no exception for being a celebratory moment.
futureReuse: design-system/COMPONENTS.md § SuccessState explicitly notes this is reusable anywhere else a completed, positive action deserves a dedicated confirmation moment (e.g. a future standalone 'course completed' screen) — not built as a separate screen today since Quiz Results already embeds an inline completion banner using the same tokens (screens/quiz-results.json).
